finalText:
`buildRows()` in `[report.js:11](src/report.js:11)` already gives clean data. `cli.js:8` parses argv and calls `toTable`.

Plan: parse `--json` in `main`, skip `toTable` when set, do `JSON.stringify(buildRows(), null, 2)` instead.

Tradeoff: keep it inline in `cli.js` versus a `toJson` helper in `format.js` to match `toTable`. I'd add the helper, for symmetry with the existing formatter.

Say the word and I'll implement it.
